trial_info.title: A Phase I/Ib Global, Multicenter, Open-label Umbrella Study Evaluating the Safety and Efficacy of Targeted Therapies in Subpopulations of Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (INTRINSIC)

patient_to_trial_evaluation.reasoning: The patient meets several inclusion criteria, including age, metastatic colorectal cancer, ECOG performance status, and willingness to undergo molecular profiling. The patient has a creatinine of 1.8 and eGFR of 35mL/min/1.73m^2, which is below the inclusion criteria of adequate organ function (creatinine clearance <60 mL/min, bilirubin >1.5x ULN). The patient also has KRAS G13D mutation, which needs to be investigated if it is suitable for the targeted therapy in the study. It's unclear if this trial includes treatment for patients with the patient's specific KRAS mutation. We need to confirm that the target therapy options include KRAS G13D mutations. The patient also needs to be screened for any active infections that would exclude her from the trial.
